headword: {預金通帳|よきんつうちょう}

definitions.explanation: A small booklet issued by a bank in which deposits, withdrawals, and the running balance of a savings account are recorded. Still widely used in Japan alongside digital banking.

examples.japanese: {預金通帳|よきんつうちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記帳|きちょう}→記帳：18809_kichou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{引|ひ}き{出|だ}し→引き出し：01498_hikidashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{預金通帳|よきんつうちょう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{印鑑|いんかん}→印鑑：05290_inkan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: You need the bankbook and a personal seal to make a withdrawal.

examples.japanese: {預金通帳|よきんつうちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧なくした⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{再発行|さいはっこう}して→再発行する：21951_saihakkousuru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I lost my bankbook, so I had the bank reissue it.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{預金|よきん}→預金：05420_yokin⟧ (bank deposit) and ⟦{通帳|つうちょう}→通帳：09924_tsuuchou⟧ (passbook). A bank-issued booklet that records all account activity. Japanese banks still make heavy use of these paper passbooks, and ATMs have a dedicated slot for printing updates in them.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {預金通帳|よきんつうちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記帳|きちょう}→記帳：18809_kichou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to update the passbook (print new entries)
- {預金通帳|よきんつうちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{再発行|さいはっこう}する→再発行する：21951_saihakkousuru⟧: to reissue a passbook
- {預金通帳|よきんつうちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{繰|く}り{越|こ}す: to move the balance to a new book when the old one is full
- {預金通帳|よきんつうちょう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{印鑑|いんかん}→印鑑：05290_inkan⟧: passbook and personal seal (often required together)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{通帳|つうちょう}→通帳：09924_tsuuchou⟧: passbook — the shorter, more colloquial form; often used alone when the context is clear
- ⟦{口座|こうざ}→口座：05419_kouza⟧: bank account — the underlying account itself, of which the passbook is a record
- ⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧バンキング: online banking — the digital alternative to a paper passbook
